info.syllabusName: Vietnamese Culture _ Cơ sở văn hóa Việt Nam
info.timeAllocation:
Study hour (150h)
= 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
This course is designed to provide students with a understanding of the foundations and the dimensions of Vietnamese culture, origin, characteristic; pay particular attention to the relationship between Vietnamese culture and the present-day life of the Vietnamese people and to the different elements of the culture which are under the social structures, belief systems, literature, arts, customs, etc... Topics mainly include: (1) the foundations of Vietnamese civilization: its geography, language, and history; (2) the core concepts in Vietnamese thoughts and religions: Aninism, Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, Catholicism, the new sects religion;...(3) Literature (4) Society and Life, including education, the role of women, Vietnamese food, festivals and leisure activities ; (5) Arts and Architecture (6) Vietnamese performing arts like Ca trù, Tuồng, Hát Bội...
-Teaching method: Presentation, Discussion, teamwork, critical thinking, field-trip.
info.studentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time.
- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose.
- Promptly access to the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.

Explain Vietnam's history and the change of Vietnamese culture over the different historical periods.

assessments.gradingGuide:
Each team needs to create a Timeline of Vietnamese Cultural History (following the timeline from the founding of the country to the present) –
Presentation: In-class presentation of 25–30 minutes, followed by 5–10 minutes Q&A.
AI usage: AI tools are allowed (for research, analysis, slide design, images, charts, etc.), but the final work must demonstrate critical thinking, creativity, and originality.
Submission format:
• 01 visual product: timeline infographic (can be presented using Canva, PowerPoint, Notion, Miro, etc.) - format file: JPEG/PNG/PDF
• 01 description: explaining the implementation process, reflecting on the role of AI support - format file: Word/PDF
assessments.note:
The lecturer is the one who decides the group project subject.
The mark will be given based on each student's performance, not on the whole group's. It means each student will get their own mark.
Group size: 3-7 people
A.i. Usage log: Students are encouraged to use it during their assignments. If used, an explanation must be submitted according to the following requirements: (State AI tools: Name, role, and stage of use; adhere to AI ethics and technical principles.
Analyze support: Specify the level of AI contribution (e.g., search, image generation, content editing, visualization).
Self-assess: Assess the balance between team/individual contributions and AI, ensuring humans play a central role.
Option 2: (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal

Option 1: Class room/or outside;
Essay Exercise: Based on the content of the field trip, group students create an Essay introducing Vietnamese cultural characteristics...
Formal Requirements – Essay exercise:
1. Length & Format
Length: 1200–1500 words (excluding references).
Format: Word or PDF.
Font: Times New Roman or Arial, size 12, line spacing 1.5.
Margins: A4 paper, 2.5 cm on all sides.
Page numbers: Bottom right corner.

2. Structure of the Essay
Title Page: Include the student’s full name, class, instructor’s name, course title, and submission date.
Introduction (≈10–15% of essay)
Body (≈70–75% of essay)
Conclusion (≈10–15% of essay)
References: Use APA 7th edition citation style (minimum of 3 scholarly sources, including books, journal articles, or reliable academic resources).

3. Academic Requirements
Proper in-text citations are used whenever ideas, data, or information are used.
No plagiarism (similarity < 20%).

AI usage: AI tools are allowed (for research, analysis, slide design, images, charts, etc.), but the final work must demonstrate critical thinking, creativity, and originality.
Submission format:
Essay - Format Files: Word/PDF
A.i. Usage log: Format Files: .docx/PDF
